# Yama solver plan (test/bosses/yama_solver.lua)

**Purpose.** A bot that plays the real route (Voice of Yama's Travel, the throne's Challenge) and
kills Yama solo with no cheats, perceiving only what a client is sent, to exercise every mechanic
for the wire audit (docs/rsprox-analysis/yama/README.md). Duo is a second seat with its own client.

**Kit** (test/bosses/fixtures/yama_kit.ini, generated by
docs/rsprox-analysis/yama/tools/make_yama_fixture.py): the recorder's worn and carried items at
index 4498 tick 684; the rune pouch (fire, soul, cosmic) is replaced by the same runes loose, one
super restore making room. Recorded stats. Arceuus spellbook. Contract signed (the fixture states it).
Dark Demonbane under Mark of Darkness (the recorder casts it, [16259]) on Yama and the flares; the
emberlight swapped in for the Judge's magic-prayer turns, as the recorder does ([865], [873]).

## Threat field (expected HP, tick mapping per CONTENT_SOLVER_MANUAL Part 2)

Observation tick F is the tick whose END I see; a click moves me during F+1; a hazard judged on T
reads my tile at the end of T-1. So to dodge a hit at T I click by the end of T-2.

| threat | perception | when it lands | dodge | cost if taken |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| regular fire/shadow | Yama's spot 3246/3243 + seq 12144 (seen at A) | A+3 | matching protect prayer on by A+2 | 0 prayed, else 0..46 |
| melee | seq 12146 when adjacent | A+1 | Protect from Melee while adjacent | 6 prayed, 46 not |
| rock/spike | seq 12145 + spot 3253/3256 | A+6 | middle tile of a lit matching glyph by A+5 | 40..80 |
| meteor | seq 12148 + spot 3270, npc 14182 over my tile at A+2 | A+6 | fire glyph, or 4+ tiles from its middle by A+5 | 121/80/40 |
| root | seq 12148 + spot 3259 | A+5 | shadow glyph | 20..60 + bind |
| wave | map anim 3265/3266 (kind, first-seen tick t0) | t0 + floor(delay/30) on my tile | step off the crossing tile a tick before it | 0..20, prayers disabled |
| streak | map anim 3267 tiles | next tick on the tile | off the lane | 10..20 |
| crash | map anim 3262 on my own tile (rock) | +3 | any step off the tile | 12..20 |
| flare | npc 14179 + timed bar | bar end | kill first (Dark Demonbane) | scaled explosion |
| judge | npc 14180, surges 13507 | | hop stones, hit him | |

## Modes

`approach` (Voice Travel → the throne, press Challenge) → `fight` (phases 1..3: attack Yama from range
with Dark Demonbane, flares first, glyph on a special's tell, step off wave/crash tiles) → `judge`
(hop the stones, alternate styles against his prayer, back to fight) → `done` (despawn seen, or death).

Survival: eat a manta at ≤ 55 HP, drink a prayer potion at ≤ 25 prayer, cure poison when poisoned.

## Probes the first seed prints (a `dbg` check row per event)

- first-seen tick of each wave (t0, kind), each special's tell tick and the landing;
- the prayer on at each regular's landing tick (tick log `raider` rows) against the telegraph;
- hits taken by cause (ticklog `hit_player` + npc types) to catch a wrong threat rule.

## PASS row (decide on 48 seeds, ≤10 lanes, `nice -n 5`)

- solo, no contract, no cheats, real route;
- Yama killed through both Judges and phase 3; no player death;
- the Judge dies to the bot's real hits (stones hopped, his prayer respected);
- no style-wrong prayer on a telegraphed regular (prayer read at its landing, audited from the tick log).

Duo: two seats on 8 seeds: creator west / partner east, drops split per raider, each seat perceives its
own client. Lane parity: one live seed against scriptrun with `--unlocked`.

## Result (48 seeds y000..y047, 10 lanes, nice 5; docs/rsprox-analysis/yama/README.md section 11)

47/48 kills with no death and no cheats (the run needs no `--dev`); both Judges killed by the bot's
hits in every kill; 0 of 3,895 telegraphed regulars landed on a style-wrong prayer (25 found the
prayer shut by a wave's 3-tick block). The one death (y046) is phase 2: three stomp specials not
absorbed and a melee, after its 12 mantas.

How it plays (each a fix found on a seed read in full):
- one press round a tick: casts never wait, the rest goes in one `t.together` capped at a tick
  (`t.TOGETHER_CONFIRM_TICKS = 1`); Mark of Darkness is a button press, its chat line confirms it;
- specials from Yama's seq plus the first channel that names the element (his spot unless the
  bot's own impact spot lands that tick, the stomp's overhead line, the chat line); the glyph by the
  tick before the landing (A+5, the root A+4); out of reach and at 80 or less, eat;
- phase 3's regular styles from the token stream (crashes on slots 0, 3, 7, 10 of the 10-slot
  repeat), the spot confirming when it is readable;
- waves: the jump in the 3265/3266 row count names a new wave (they overlap in phase 3); the step
  off is chosen two ticks ahead from the delay table; crash rocks are remembered for their flight;
- the walk home goes round the ring next to Yama (he melees anyone in it on his attack tick);
- the Judge: stones within 3 rows ahead, never under a surge's column; two platform tiles swapped on
  each of his casts; magic when his frame is 7 (melee), the emberlight when it is 6 (magic).

Not reached: the duo (the Join needs mutual friends; no lane can add a friend) and the live-lane
parity seed (README section 8).
